extension.summary: Sleep timer with volume fade-out, early TV power-off and screensaver handover.
Sleeptimer mit Lautstaerke-Ausblendung, vorzeitigem TV-Aus und Bildschirmschoner-Uebergabe.
extension.description: Stops playback after a configurable time, fading the volume out gradually so you get a chance to intervene. Optionally switches the TV off earlier while audio keeps playing, which is useful for falling asleep to a movie. User activity (pause, seek, navigation) restarts the timer. The TV-off command is sent through an IR blaster helper command and is therefore treated as a toggle and never sent twice; the TV is switched back on with a CEC command.

Beendet die Wiedergabe nach einer einstellbaren Zeit und blendet die Lautstaerke vorher langsam aus, damit man noch eingreifen kann. Optional wird der Fernseher schon vorher abgeschaltet, waehrend der Ton weiterlaeuft. Benutzeraktivitaet (Pause, Spulen, Navigation) startet den Timer neu.
extension.news: v3.0.0 - Rewritten as an explicit state machine (Idle / Watching / WatchingTvOff / RampDown / TurnOff) - Single elapsed timer, both thresholds relative to playback start - Optional early TV power-off while audio continues - Additive volume ramp with saved-volume restore on every exit path - Activity detection via Player callbacks plus global idle time, no reliance on the idle timer alone - IR TV-off is sent exactly once (toggle-safe) - OSD notification when the ramp starts
